claim_text: If service providers intend to repurpose customer support transcripts for training AI models, then such training represents a distinct purpose from contract performance or routine service delivery.
extracted_sentence: When service providers intend to repurpose customer support transcripts, logs, or user communications originally collected for customer assistance to train or fine-tune general-purpose or proprietary AI foundation models, such training represents a distinct purpose from contract performance or routine service delivery.
reviewer_note: Directly supports the proposition that repurposing customer communications for AI model training constitutes a distinct purpose from routine contract performance under EDPB guidance.

claim_text: If service providers intend to repurpose customer support transcripts to train a general-purpose AI model, then they must demonstrate compelling safeguards, including pre-training redaction, opt-out mechanisms prior to data ingestion, and rigorous risk assessments.
extracted_sentence: Where controllers rely on legitimate interest under Article 6(1)(f), they must demonstrate compelling safeguards, including pre-training redaction, opt-out mechanisms prior to data ingestion, and rigorous risk assessments demonstrating that user reasonable expectations are not violated.
reviewer_note: Sentence directly substantiates the mandatory safeguards (redaction, opt-out, and risk assessments) required when relying on legitimate interest for AI training.

claim_text: If personal data are collected for a specific purpose, then further processing for a purpose incompatible with the initial purpose is not allowed, unless it is for archiving, scientific, historical, or statistical purposes.
extracted_sentence: Personal data shall be collected for specified, explicit and legitimate purposes and not further processed in a manner that is incompatible with those purposes; further processing for archiving purposes in the public interest, scientific or historical research purposes or statistical purposes shall, in accordance with Article 89(1), not be considered to be incompatible with the initial purposes.
reviewer_note: Statutory text of GDPR Article 5(1)(b) directly substantiates the purpose limitation rule and its limited research/statistical exceptions.
